policy.include: visible Raspberry Pi board body, soldered/header parts and native protruding ports
policy.exclude: hands, shadows, packaging, external cases, cables and separate accessories
policy.occlusion: visible extent only; do not hallucinate invisible full extent
policy.multiple_objects: separate box per visible board, including image-boundary partial boards
policy.boundary_precision: approximate visual draft from aspect-preserved individual review images; not human-certified
policy.allowed_use: qualitative demonstration and human annotation review only
policy.not_allowed_use: mAP/IoU benchmark ground truth or training labels without reviewed authorization
